component.name: unsloth-studio-amd-devenv-shell
component.description: Nix/system layer of the Unsloth Studio AMD/ROCm devenv: the transitive store-path closure of the flake's devShell (dev tooling + ROCm runtime libraries). The Python ML stack is NOT here - see the sibling SBOM nix/sbom-python.cdx.json.

properties.value: no standard pkg:nix PackageURL scheme exists; components carry no purl and are identified by name+version plus the nix:store-path / nix:output-hash properties (the exact provenance) instead
